name: Platinum Vape 510 Cartridge | Polar Peach
description: Sweet meets chill with Polar Peach — a juicy burst of ripe peach flavor layered with an invigorating icy finish. This refreshing sativa delivers smooth, frosty clouds and an uplifting, energetic high that keeps the vibe crisp and clear. Perfect for when you want fruity sweetness with a polar-cool edge.
